title: Multiplying Fractions
description: Class 5 Maths: multiply a fraction by a whole number and a fraction by a fraction, and find a fraction of a quantity — with worked examples and free tests.

topics.title: Fraction of a Quantity & × a Whole Number
topics.concept:
Finding a fraction of an amount means multiply. To find 1/3 of 9, divide 9 by 3 → 3.

To multiply a fraction by a whole number, multiply the numerator by the whole number: 1/2 × 4 = 4/2 = 2.

recap: Fraction × whole: multiply the numerator by the whole number.

topics.title: Multiplying a Fraction by a Fraction
topics.concept:
To multiply two fractions, multiply the numerators and multiply the denominators:

1/2 × 1/2 = (1×1)/(2×2) = 1/4. So half of a half is a quarter.

Simplify the answer if you can.

questions.q: To multiply two fractions, you multiply the…
questions.explanation: Multiply tops together and bottoms together.

questions.q: 3/5 of 30 students play sport. How many?
Which is larger: 1/2 of 8 or 1/4 of 20?
questions.explanation: 1/2 of 8 = 4 and 1/4 of 20 = 5, so 1/4 of 20 is larger.
